{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# This is required because 24 patients were re-tested and appear twice
print(f"Total rows before dedup: {len(df)}")
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')
print(f"Total rows after dedup: {len(df_dedup)}")

# Final count of unique patients (enrolled) — no exclusion of -999
num_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(num_patients)"}
